name: Proving Grounds - a spawner, and the smallest capability that unlocked it
notes: Mario's fourth requested design, and the biggest kernel gap this spike found: nothing could create an entity after tick 0 before this session. structure.bench.hatchery's spawn field plus pulse/spawn.ts's spawning() phase is scoped as a combat ability, not production - no cost, no resource - specifically so it stays out of Milestone 2's still-unauthorised economy (specs/open-questions.md Q26). Two troopers besiege the hatchery; watch entity.spawned events appear mid-Pulse in the headless log (not just at tick 0) as spawnlings emerge to defend it, capped at maxAlive: 3 at a time.
